title: XV6-RISC-V — Operating System Kernel Extensions
description: Extended an educational operating system kernel (XV6) to deepen understanding of low-level systems, process management, and operating system design.
results: Worked at kernel level to understand process scheduling, memory management, and system calls

Gained practical experience with low-level programming and hardware-software interaction
